- **[When scoped Git change control is enough](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/products/evidence-registry/study-scoped-git.html).** Both workflows accepted 2 authorized repairs in 4 matched paths. Both restored the remote file state. Scoped Git retained the original effect in ordinary branch ancestry and created 0 additional receipt files. The governed arm retained it on an audit ref and created 14 additional receipt files.
- **[When a second receiver check changes closure](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/products/evidence-registry/study-crossed-receiver.html).** Both placements verified 8 of 8 withheld-primary cases with 8 caller requests each. Gateway delivery added 2,033 HTTP response bytes per verified fallback across both hops.
- **[Which scope earns a verifier rollout?](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/products/evidence-registry/study-verifier-rollout.html).** The shared copy-09 failure routed to a specialist. Both workflows matched the expected route at 66 scripted checkpoints and each read 75 evidence documents. The serialized handoff wrote 2367 bytes. Both caught a missed invalidation when the index next returned the current revision.
- **[Did extracted routines help on later synthesis tasks?](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/products/evidence-registry/study-forward-transfer.html).** In 64 descriptive-query cells at the proposal cap, prioritizing expanded length changed query-aware whole programs from 28 to 8 verified cells. Query-aware routines verified 20 and 20. The earlier ranking depended on the scheduler as well as the cap.
- **[Can a reviewer recover the decision and its limits?](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/products/evidence-registry/study-claim-review.html).** Usable citations on the five claim questions: ordinary register 5/5, linked register 4/5. Both cited all four navigation targets.
- **[When arrivals outrun verification capacity](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/products/evidence-registry/study-verification-load.html).** At four arrivals per tick, each queue had 32 unfinished checks after the last arrival. On draining the workload both verified 24 jobs. The ordinary queue made 96 bookkeeping writes, the obligation queue 128.
